programme.desc: Slade and the new producer Tim Guidroz go out on their first turkey hunt together, and even though the weather is not ideal, they get the job done on a Wilkinson County gobbler.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.sub-title: Chasing Pelagics in Big Seas Out of Key West
programme.desc: Captains Scott Walker and Steve Rodger fish out of Key West for tuna and sailfish while battling big sharks and even bigger seas.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.sub-title: Islamorada Blackfins and Mahis with Capt. Scott Stoky
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve start the season offshore at Plantation Boat Mart with Capt. Scott Stoky by chasing Islamorada tuna and mahi.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve catch a mixed bag while bottom fishing off of Islamorada with Capt. Scott Stoky.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.sub-title: Yellowtail and Lemons at Hawks Cay
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve go yellowtailing out of Hawks Cay for some tasty yellowtail snapper; Steve picks a battle with a big lemon shark.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.sub-title: Reef Fishing out of Hawks Cay
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve bounce around the reefs of Hawks Cay, catching a wide variety of reef dwellers.

programme.title: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Captains Scott and Steve take their brand new 36' Invincible out of Plantation Boat Mart to fly the kites for some early-season sailfish.

programme.title: The Captain's Log
programme.desc: Captain Jonathan Moss is fishing one of his favorite Central Florida lakes for largemouth bass!

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: The Montana adventure continues on private lakes for trophy trout, where fish stories are born.

programme.title: The Direction
programme.sub-title: Winter Time Bassin' on Dale Hallow
programme.desc: John and a group of friends make an annual winter trip to catch smallmouth in the dead of KY wintertime on Dale Hollow Lake; Dale Hollow holds the world-record smallmouth catch; Nick and Mark Stowe joined the group a few years back.

programme.title: LBP Spotlight
programme.desc: LBP Spotlights Internet Personality and YouTube Star Lawson Lindsey as he searches for trophy fish at the Headwaters of the Loxahatchee River.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: In a predominantly male profession, U.S. Navy veteran Kristina Hoyer recounts her incredible challenges while becoming a Navy rescue swimmer.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Cast aims to reveal various angling experiences tied to a deeper meaning through the lens of personal experiences; from fresh water in the Midwest, to exploring the saltwater of the coasts.

programme.title: Saltwater Underground With Nick Honachefsky
programme.desc: Nick hops on board with Capt. Jimmy Gagliardini bailing reef fish of snapper, mahi, grouper, macks and more along the Marathon patch reefs.

programme.title: Sportsman's Journal
programme.desc: We head back to the Mecca of Jumbo Perch at Lake Cascade, ID!

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny Pruitt travels around the country fishing in some of the nation's best kept secrets all while discovering the communities, culture, food, and the people that make each episode unique and entertaining.

programme.title: BaitFuel Fishing Tour
programme.desc: Qualifier 5 is the second event day in Cornwall, Ontario taking place on Lake St. Francis, part of the famed St. Lawrence Seaway.

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour
programme.sub-title: Sight Casting Rising Trout in Idaho
programme.desc: Setting out across the country on a road trip visiting and fishing with local fly shops to highlight small businesses that drive a beloved sport: fly-fishing.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Part 2 of Captain Mike Anderson and Captain Ryan Rickard keeping count of their catch on an epic day of fishing in Steinhatchee, FL.
